study type: Ex-vivo analysis of clinical samples and in vitro experimental study
cohort: Participants were human fetal membranes obtained from patients with preterm prelabor rupture of membranes (pPROM) and from women undergoing normal term cesarean sections not in labor.
finding: The study found no changes in PEDF mRNA expression in pPROM compared to term births or after treatment with CSE or LPS, but sulforaphane significantly increased PEDF mRNA expression.
cross-section timing: Samples were collected at the time of delivery.
gest_age: Preterm (from pPROM) and term (from normal cesarean sections)
